name: Reputation
oneLiner: Enterprise reputation and customer experience platform (formerly Reputation.com) that combines reviews, listings, surveys, social and AI search visibility for multi-location brands.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant, hospitality, automotive and healthcare brands that need reviews, surveys and listings managed centrally with enterprise reporting.

updates.text: Expanded the platform with deeper customer insights features.
Unveiled new AI-powered products and features for brand intelligence.
Launched Reputation IQ (plain-English questions across your data), an expanded AI Reputation Manager (how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity present your brand) and AI Location Presence Insights.

features: Review monitoring and response across Google, Yelp, Facebook, Tripadvisor and other sites from one inbox
Review requests by SMS, email and QR code, triggered by dine-in, delivery or POS events
Surveys and customer feedback alongside public reviews
Sentiment and text analytics that group feedback into themes such as service or cleanliness
AI search visibility tools: AI Reputation Manager and AI Location Presence Insights
Reputation IQ for asking questions of your feedback data in plain English

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Reputation does not publish prices.

notes: Rebranded from Reputation.com to Reputation; still uses the reputation.com domain, HQ San Ramon, CA; marked its 20th year in March 2026. No acquisition of the company found. A CostBench page claims public plans of $80–$150/month and a February 2026 price cut; not confirmed on reputation.com and inconsistent with its enterprise sales model, so left out. Mitchells & Butlers case study dates from 2018. Dropped from the current review: the claim that its portfolio is 'primarily healthcare' (it also targets hospitality, automotive and others; not re-checked). Also copied to reputation-com.json.
